verdict.rationale: Model-performance measurement is a fair question for an ML fraud-scoring product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only fraud-rate trend analytics, per-payment risk factors, and sandbox test cards that force a given risk level. None of these documents precision/recall on the merchant's own traffic or shadow-mode evaluation of new models or rules before they make decisions. Sandbox test cards are dry-run testing, not shadow trials on live traffic.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can measure the model itself — precision and recall on my traffic, shadow-mode trials of new models or rules before they take over decisions
